description: Polymarket: Browse Polymarket prediction markets by tag/category, with everything you need to trade what you find — conditionId, CLOB token ids, outcome names and prices, current bid/ask, end date and the minimum price tick. Use this when you know the category you want; use x402-poly-price to search by keyword, x402-poly-markets for the busiest prediction market overall, and x402-polymarket-scan for whole events instead of a single market.
name: x402-polymarket
